column9: The new unconditional require loads diagnostics.js, but pg-pool's package.json files allowlist includes only index.js and esm. The published package will omit diagnostics.js, causing require('pg-pool') and require('pg') to fail with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Include the new file in the package contents.

The tracing wrapper is installed after the timeout code captures queryCallback. When query_timeout expires, the timer calls that original callback directly and replaces query.callback with a no-op before the scheduled handleError runs. Consequently, a traced query publishes start but never error or asyncEnd, leaving subscribers' spans unfinished. Route timeout completion through the tracing wrapper.

Calling origCb(err, res) loses the callback receiver. Query.handleReadyForQuery and Query.handleError previously invoked this.callback(...), so callbacks received the Query instance as this. With tracing enabled, callbacks that access this.text or other query state now fail or behave differently. Preserve the original receiver when forwarding the callback.
